heroHeadline: SpaceX IPO Confirms Starlink at 10.3M Users, $11.4B Revenue — EU Moves to Limit Starlink's European Spectrum Expansion
heroSubtitle: SpaceX's Nasdaq IPO prospectus filed May 22 confirmed Starlink has 10.3 million active subscribers in Q1 2026 — more than double year-over-year — and $11.39 billion in 2025 revenue. The European Commission proposed satellite spectrum rules on May 27 that would structurally favor European operators over Starlink in the 2 GHz Direct-to-Device band, reflecting growing 'digital sovereignty' concerns in the EU. In Africa, a joint Africa CEO Forum/Askya Investment Partners report warned on May 26 that African governments risk losing $2–4 billion annually to satellite operators operating under light-touch regulatory regimes — while South Africa launched a new Mobile Digital Lab in Phokeng on May 26 to address its 13 million still-offline citizens. The Starlink constellation exceeded 10,000 spacecraft with a Memorial Day launch of 29 satellites on May 24.
footerNote: Data sourced from ITU, GSMA, World Bank, A4AI, SpaceX IPO prospectus, Amazon Leo filings, NTIA/FCC, and major international research outlets. Contested figures noted with confidence levels.
